steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: We don't usually greet our visitors at gunpoint, save for special occasions.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Pardon me if you're dissatisfied with your treatment in any way.

steps.name: Twisted Monster
steps.text: (Indecipherable howling)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (Not reacting at all to what I say. Is communication completely out the window?)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (Not many human features left to show. Is it all hidden under those scales?)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (...I remember Iberian files mentioning this sort of mutation before...)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You couldn't be...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Oofff...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Nope, the wheelchair's not going to cut it.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (Strange. Something's not right.)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (Is its target... not me?)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (Where is it aiming? What is it trying to—)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Too close...!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (Forget it, I'll have to worry about that later!)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Nuh-uh, just because I'm physically handicapped doesn't mean you can pick on me, visitor!

steps.name: Twisted Monster
steps.text: (Angry howling)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Stop right there—!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Nope—I can't just let you slip away!
When the elderly chat, the topic inevitably turns to Laterano
They call it bright, abundant, safe for all, disturbed by none.
They say it's true paradise on Terra.
The truth is, they all know the monastery's been adrift for decades, and only a dwindling few remain who've actually seen Laterano before. Perhaps two or three, or maybe just it's Bishop Stefano now.
They bring up Laterano, but the object of their nostalgia is a dream they're long overdue to wake from.
A dream where the sun shines and the flowers are underfoot forever.
Just as the monastery used to be, all those years ago.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: They're about to wither.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: They bloomed earlier than last year. I could guess they'd wither sooner too. I just didn't think it'd be this soon...

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: The few you picked were in wonderful blossom. They're not about to wilt yet.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: How pretty. Who'll be receiving these?

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: I'm too late. There's no giving them now.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: They can't save anyone...

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Sorrow. Pain. Despair.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Mm... such complex overtones. There are other emotions hidden inside you, too...

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Are you angered?

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: I wouldn't dare... You're a guest of His Excellency, Seniora Arturia.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: You wouldn't dare, that's all. A very honest answer.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: My intuition has always been unusually accurate, Senior Florist. You seem to loath me a little.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: No, not at all. You needn't worry.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: If anything is troubling you, I could be of help to you, I think.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Help...? Er, I'm not sure what you mean, Seniora Arturia.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: What would you help with?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: This hinges on your thoughts. It's not something for me to decide.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Of course, you may not need any help at all. Call me meddlesome if you wish, or a bearer of bad intent, none of which I would mind. It's for you to say.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I just want to hear your thoughts... your own thoughts.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: You're a strange one, Seniora Arturia.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: You flatter me.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: You say you can help me...

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Of course, so long as you need.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: No, there's no need.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Perhaps you could... well, there's a great many you can help, but you can't help me.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Seniora Arturia, would you claim to be able to raise the dead?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Can you make the harvest rich, or see that the cold winds stop?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I'm very sorry, but I can't.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Then can you return us to your original lives, see that the barriers of old are no more?

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: You could never.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Then what of you, Clément?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Have you never once entertained being able to solve all you speak of, by your own hands?

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: ...I've tried...

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: But it was no use. I've tried more than once, but I couldn't do it.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: The more effort we put in, the worse things get, more often than not...

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: No one can make it all better. The Abbot can't, Gerald can't... and neither can I.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: You can't help me, Seniora Arturia.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Please... don't bring this up again. And don't think I need the help of someone like you.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: You ask what my thoughts are. Let me tell you: I have no thoughts at all.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: What else can I come up with? The coming winter is too cold.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Cold. Yes, this heart is like soil frozen through, beneath a sheet of iciness...

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Yet I can feel notes lurking beneath the ice... I wonder how powerfully they will move us?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: It's not yet time. This composition is not bound for completion yet...

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Such unbearableness, such tolerance... mm... in times like these, I cannot help myself.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Let me see...

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Ah, this melody is a perfect fit for the occasion.
Federico.
I told you, your melodies are too rhythmic, too unperturbed. You should know that an all-too-rational melody will lack the sentiments to shake people. There's no warmth, nor passion...
Sometimes, I can only be curious.
Federico, when will you finally realize... why it is you search?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: (Strings?)

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: (No, this is more than strings. There are Originium Arts effecting something within.)

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: (These Arts, and this melody. Could they be...?)

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: (The sounds are nearing.)

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: (Are they above?)

steps.name: Monastery Inhabitant
steps.text: What's today's song? It's beautiful.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Do you hear music every day here?

steps.name: Startled Inhabitant
steps.text: Erk! Wh—Who...?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I am Executor Federico of the Notarial Hall. Please answer my question.

steps.name: Startled Inhabitant
steps.text: Notarial Hall? What does that even...? Oh, I see, you're that guest from Laterano they were talking about, aren't you?

steps.name: Startled Inhabitant
steps.text: Sometimes you can, er, hear this music around this time? I'm not too sure myself.

steps.name: Startled Inhabitant
steps.text: Oh, right! I believe I heard about someone by the sacrarium who plays a cello or something...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Where is the sacrarium?

steps.name: Startled Inhabitant
steps.text: On the roof. Take the stairs outside and you'll be right—wait, ex-excuse me, Senior?!

steps.name: Startled Inhabitant
steps.text: What was the rush...? Such a strange man.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Welcome back, boss.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Yeah. How ready are we to move out?

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: More or less good. We don't have much to take with us, and we'd be overburdened anyway if we did.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: But there's been no word from the young ones we sent to scout the way... They might not make it in time for tomorrow morning.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Wait a little longer.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Stefano and I have talked it over. That we're leaving... he'll let it be. So no need to rush it now. If we still hear nothing by nightfall, then I'll take a team myself to find them.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Sure. I'll update everyone in a minute.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Oh, boss! There's one other thing...

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Hyman hasn't come back either... I looked around for her, but she's nowhere to be found.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Is Raimund still gone as well?

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Got it. Leave this to me.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: But if Hyman never shows up, should we... wait?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Tomorrow morning at the latest. If anyone's still not back after Matins, you and Raimund will set off with rest as planned.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I'll stay behind. Dead or alive, I'll find Hyman.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I swear, I'd never abandon a single one of you.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: That's all we're worried about.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: *mumble*, you always take too much on yourself.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Let's not bring up that name again.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: You call me boss. I have a duty to find you a way out.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: And I see you walking down a dead end.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Hahaha. I know what I'm doing.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Forget all that, no need to look so sad. Go on, get everything good and ready.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Shift change.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Wargh...!

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: There's a fright... hi there, Serpilia.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Who else would you expect? Does Federico ever bother with this sort of work?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: How's the girl in there...? Doing bad?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Bad in a way. She hasn't said a word. Seems she's in shock.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: I eyed over the scene. Aren't you the least bit curious about what actually happened?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: I... can more or less guess.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: You and I both know how powerful a gun is. With that much blood loss... anyone would be doomed, wouldn't they?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Your face says I'm on the mark.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Did you tell her?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: What? Oh, as in, that she might already be dead? Of course not.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: She's unsettled right now. Telling her the truth could just as well cause more problems.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: So what is your plan? Lie to her and say nothing's wrong, muddle through, figure out the rest later, I bet?

spans.text: your plan? Lie to her and say nothing's wrong, muddle through, figure out the rest later, I bet?

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: You make it sound so bad... but still, that's basically it.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Serpilia, something seems a little fishy with your emotions. What happened?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: None of your business. I'm doing great.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: If you say so, then. No problems in Serpilia-land.

steps.name: Richele
steps.text: Okay. I'll leave her to you.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Hmph. Every undependable bastard's on parade today.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: (An accident caused by an unintentional discharge...)

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: (Ha. And so what?)

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: (If I hadn't helped her...)

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: What? Make it quick.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Wait, what do you mean Sarkaz in the outer vicinity? Are they still trying to break your blockade?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Just a few? Scouting the road?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Fine, got it. What about Oren?

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: No, you can leave Oren to me. I'll contact him.

steps.name: Serpilia
steps.text: Listen, here's what you guys do next...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: ...Seriously... what a good runner!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: *huff*...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Or maybe I just lost it...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (Back in the old days, I would've put them away clean in a fraction of the time.)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (Times like these... I can't help but feel a little mad.)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: There you are...!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Guess it's not the time to brood just yet.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: (The sound of strings is growing clear. I am steadily approaching the source.)

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: (But the Arts are diminishing in strength. Are they giving up casting, or... hm?)

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Who is it?

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Senior Federico? What are you doing here...?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I was not referring to you.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Er, excuse me...?

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Are you lost? If you don't mind, I can—

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Stop talking.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Mmff?! Mrmmffff!!

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: What... What was that? That monster...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I do not know.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: It's fled downstairs! Not good... Gerald's group live down there!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Stay still.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Someone is here.
I heard gunfire this way, so I came to test my luck.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Cardinal Aide Lemuen, Serpilia's report stated that you would not be operating in the field.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Don't blame her. If I'm honest, I didn't think I would be either.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: But then came a slight twist...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: We'll catch up later. Are you on your own, Federico? Is nobody else operating with you?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I am on my own.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Then let's keep it short. I'm on the trail of a surprise... visitor.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I won't keep you too long...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: So here, be good and tell me.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Which way did my 'visitor' happen to go?
